title: ASN.1 / X.690 DER canonical TLV validator with nested SEQUENCE support
contract_header:
use spec = "der_valid_spec.ode"

fn der_valid(buf: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n <= 65536
    returns spec.der_valid(buf)
    trace depends on buf, n
    stack 512
task_summary: Implement `der_valid(buf, n)`, returning `1` if `buf[0 .. n-1]` is a non-empty sequence of canonical ASN.1 / X.690 DER TLV records (supporting `BOOLEAN`, `INTEGER`, `BIT STRING`, `OCTET STRING`, `NULL`, `OBJECT IDENTIFIER`, and nested `SEQUENCE` containers up to depth 3, with canonical short/long length encodings and all canonicality checks from `der_valid_spec.ode`), and `0` otherwise.
